body:
The Linnik interval cover now follows from two smaller source inputs: finite phase concentration and binary entropy. The damped tail, local shift stability, interval packing and bridges to the existing Gallagher word count are proved. The exact original main statement is reassembled with no sorry in its own proof body and remains CONDITIONAL.

Added 44 declarations in 12 new modules. There are 29 PROVED theorems, two clean data definitions, two OPEN leaves and eleven CONDITIONAL assemblies. Every declaration has a plain math twin, source page and concrete instance. The actual binary sets have certified positive measure. All 40 upstream Lean files stay byte identical.

All 40 baseline modules built. The complete axiom audit and twelve exact target type checks pass. The statement seal prints SEAL PASS. All 44 source comparisons are MATCH. The folder sorry delta is plus two, both new LEAF inputs. The existing Novelty1620 source remains absent and is logged NEEDS STEVE.

AI wrote the Lean code. Binary Goldbach is open.

The final branch gate report follows.

```text
RESULT PASS  CODEX-task412  folder Linnik1951  base 33fac6218
WARN 11 theorems use other axioms, label them CONDITIONAL or sorry: 'LeanLab.Linnik1951.exceptional_error412' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | 'LeanLab.Linnik1951.error_bound412' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | 'LeanLab.Linnik1951.linnik1951_decomposed412' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | 'LeanLab.Linnik1951.exceptional_system_cover412' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | 'LeanLab.Linnik1951.exceptional_prime_mass412' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | 'LeanLab.Linnik1951.large_value_measure412' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | 'LeanLab.Linnik1951.finite_large_value_measure412' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] | 'LeanLab.Linnik1951.large_value_measure_proved412' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
```

The initial gate found two bookkeeping failures. Both are resolved in the final gate.

```text
FAIL uncommitted changes remain, commit before publishing
FAIL LOG.md has a line starting CODEX
```

The complete multiline audit records thirteen sorry dependent declarations. Two axiom lists wrap, so the gate warning counts eleven. All are labelled OPEN or CONDITIONAL.

Main 33fac6218 is merged. The publication LOG conflict preserves both append blocks.
